name: vibestack

scripts.eliza:gen: node vendor/eliza/vibestack/spec.ts gen --owner core vendor/eliza && node vendor/eliza/vibestack/spec.ts gen --owner cloud vendor/eliza && node vendor/eliza/vibestack/spec.ts gen --owner agent vendor/eliza && pnpm --filter @elizaos/core build && pnpm --filter @elizaos/cloud exec vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');for(const f of fs.globSync('vendor/eliza/packages/cloud/src/**/*.sql')){const d='vendor/eliza/packages/cloud/dist/'+path.relative('vendor/eliza/packages/cloud',f);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(f,d);}" && pnpm --filter @elizaos/agent build
scripts.selftest:tools:a: node --test --test-name-pattern="^the tools each check catches its own kind of mistake in shard a " vibestack/selftest.ts
scripts.selftest:tools:b: node --test --test-name-pattern="^the tools each check catches its own kind of mistake in shard b " vibestack/selftest.ts
scripts.selftest:tools:rest: node --test --test-skip-pattern="^the tools each check catches its own kind of mistake in shard [ab] " vibestack/selftest.ts
scripts.selftest:docs: node --test --test-name-pattern="^the documents name what exists " vibestack/selftests/docs.ts
scripts.build: node vibestack/spec.ts tasks vibestack-studio#build && node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "fs.chmodSync('dist/spec.js', 0o755); fs.mkdirSync('dist/proof', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibestack/proof/lib.dfy', 'dist/proof/lib.dfy'); fs.cpSync('vibestack/std', 'dist/std', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('vibestack/conformance.ts', 'dist/conformance.ts')" && node vibestack/studio/pack-page.ts
scripts.analyze: knip && madge --circular vibestack packages apps && jscpd .
scripts.verify: node vibestack/spec.ts tasks build typecheck test test:browser check //#lint:js //#lint:css //#analyze --filter='!@elizaos/*'
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm --filter @repo/app... --filter '!vibestack' --filter '!@elizaos/*' build && ALCHEMY_FAST_DISTILLED=1 alchemy deploy --stage staging --adopt
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm --filter @repo/app... --filter '!vibestack' --filter '!@elizaos/*' build && ALCHEMY_FAST_DISTILLED=1 alchemy deploy --stage production --adopt

description: Feed (feed.fun) — Twitter with markets, played from your own AI, built on Vibestack.
